mentions.name: Hermes
mentions.description: A personal project manager for side projects with a CLI to view todos, projects, and ongoing long-term "areas"; it periodically nudges the user when a project is going stale and supports backdating work that was done without an associated todo.
mentions.problem: Side projects can go stale unnoticed, and work done outside planned todos gets lost.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've also recently setup Hermes to be a bit of a project manager for my side projects and it's worked quite well. Gave it a little CLI to see my todos, projects, and "areas" (ongoing long term things). Then it bugs me once in a while when a project is going stale. One of the nicest things is being able to add stuff to the past so if I did work on something but it wasn't associated with a todo I just let it know and then it'll backdate that.
